name: Find Image Online
summary: Display an image inline using the fetch_image_url tool on a Wikipedia page. One tool call, done.

steps.note: Search '<subject> wikipedia' to get the Wikipedia article URL
Call fetch_image_url(page_url=<wikipedia_url>, subject=<subject>). It returns {ok, url, markdown}. Output the markdown field directly — that renders the image inline.
Output the markdown field from fetch_image_url exactly as-is: ![subject](url). Nothing else needed.

notes: NEVER manually construct or fetch upload.wikimedia.org URLs — use fetch_image_url tool only
NEVER call web_fetch on upload.wikimedia.org — it returns 429/400
fetch_image_url handles redirect following, og:image extraction, and thumb URL parsing internally
If fetch_image_url fails, try the Wikimedia Commons page URL instead of the Wikipedia article
